Narendra Kumar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
Lko. ... on 19 October, 2023

Bench: Sangeeta Chandra, Karunesh Singh Pawar
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:68928-Db
Court No. - 10
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 8162 of 2023
Petitioner :- Narendra Kumar Tiwari
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ajay Veer Singh, Abhinav Srivastava,Piyush Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.

(1) Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.G.A. who appears for the Opposite party nos.1 to 4.
(2) This petition has been filed by the petitioner with the following main prayer:-.
"1) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus thereby directing the Opposite party nos.1 to 4 to conduct fair, impartial and expeditious investigation of F.I.R. No.450 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 409 & 120-B I.P.C.,
against the Opposite party nos.5 to 12 at Police Station Pura Kalandar, District Narendra Kumar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187547424/
1 Ayodhya, in the interest of justice."

entities.text: Narendra Kumar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (3) It is the case of the petitioner that the FIR was lodged by him on 10.09.2023 against known persons.
The Investigating Officer is not taking interest in proper investigation of the case.
Hence this petition has been filed.

(4) Learned A.G.A. on the other hand, has raised a preliminary objection saying that for the relief, as claimed in this petition, the petitioner has statutory remedy of filing a Complaint/ Application before the Judicial Magistrate, concerned, under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. as observed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sakiri Vasu Vs. State of U.P. and Others reported in 2008 (2) SCC 409,
an application can be filed to the Magistrate concerned who has very wide powers to direct and ensure a proper investigation.

entities.text: Sakiri Vasu Vs. State of U.P. and Others reported in 2008 (2) SCC 409
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He can also monitor such investigation that the investigation is done properly.

(5) This petition is finally disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to approach the Magistrate concerned under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C., who shall look into the matter and ensure that justice is done to the Complainant/ Informant.
